fields.title: 📖 Ijmāʿ: Ribā is forbidden by the Qurʾān, the Sunnah and consensus
fields.body:
🖋️ **Abū l-Ḥasan al-Māwardī** explained:

> ***“al-Māwardī said: The basis for the prohibition of Ribā is the Qurʾān, the Sunnah and then the Ijmāʿ; the Muslims have agreed upon the prohibition of Ribā.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Ribā is not an ordinary point of dispute. Its being forbidden stands by revelation and Ijmāʿ.

immutable.source: 📝 al-Māwardī, al-Ḥāwī al-Kabīr, Bd. 5, S. 73–74, Kitāb al-Buyūʿ, Bāb ar-Ribā.
